name: devices
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `devices` (`deviceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `platform` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAt` INTEGER NOT NULL, `reportTimezone` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`deviceId`))

name: app_identities
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_identities` (`identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `deviceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `profileScope` TEXT NOT NULL, `packageName` TEXT NOT NULL, `displayName` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`identityId`), FOREIGN KEY(`deviceId`) REFERENCES `devices`(`deviceId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: sessions
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `sessions` (`sessionId` TEXT NOT NULL, `originDeviceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `anchorMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `startMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `endMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `durationMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `timezone` TEXT NOT NULL, `utcOffsetSeconds` INTEGER NOT NULL, `metric` TEXT NOT NULL, `source` TEXT NOT NULL, `provisional` INTEGER NOT NULL, `transitionEstimated` INTEGER NOT NULL, `quality` TEXT NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, `deleted` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`sessionId`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT , FOREIGN KEY(`originDeviceId`) REFERENCES `devices`(`deviceId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: historical_buckets
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `historical_buckets` (`bucketId` TEXT NOT NULL, `originDeviceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `startMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `endMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `usageMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `source` TEXT NOT NULL, `timezone` TEXT NOT NULL, `quality` TEXT NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`bucketId`), FOREIGN KEY(`originDeviceId`) REFERENCES `devices`(`deviceId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT , FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: coverage
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `coverage` (`coverageId` TEXT NOT NULL, `deviceId` TEXT NOT NULL, `startMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `endMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `reason` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`coverageId`), FOREIGN KEY(`deviceId`) REFERENCES `devices`(`deviceId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: system_daily_usage
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `system_daily_usage` (`identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `reportDate` TEXT NOT NULL, `timezone` TEXT NOT NULL, `durationMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `bucketStartMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `bucketEndMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `observedAtMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`identityId`, `reportDate`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: app_preferences
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_preferences` (`identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `category` TEXT NOT NULL, `hidden` INTEGER NOT NULL, `ignored` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`identityId`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: ignore_periods
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `ignore_periods` (`periodId` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `startMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `endMs` INTEGER, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, PRIMARY KEY(`periodId`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: manual_adjustments
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `manual_adjustments` (`adjustmentId` TEXT NOT NULL, `identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `reportDate` TEXT NOT NULL, `timezone` TEXT NOT NULL, `deltaMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `note` TEXT NOT NULL, `createdAtMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `revision` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, `deleted` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY(`adjustmentId`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: app_observations
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `app_observations` (`identityId` TEXT NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `signingDigest` TEXT, `signingChanged` INTEGER NOT NULL, `observedAtMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`identityId`), FOREIGN KEY(`identityId`) REFERENCES `app_identities`(`identityId`) ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE RESTRICT )

name: collection_state
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `collection_state` (`source` TEXT NOT NULL, `recordFromMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `checkpointMs` INTEGER, `lastSuccessMs` INTEGER, `enabled` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `detail` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`source`))

name: history_import_state
sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `history_import_state` (`source` TEXT NOT NULL, `requestedStartMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `requestedEndMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `returnedStartMs` INTEGER, `returnedEndMs` INTEGER, `acceptedBuckets` INTEGER NOT NULL, `skippedBuckets` INTEGER NOT NULL, `lastAttemptMs` INTEGER NOT NULL, `status` TEXT NOT NULL, `detail` TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY(`source`))
